name: CSS Formatter
summary: Pretty-print CSS with readable indentation and spacing — locally in your browser.
description: Turn minified or messy CSS into a readable stylesheet. Supports nested blocks like @media, preserves quoted strings, and can minify back into the input.

faqs.question: Is this a full CSS parser?
faqs.answer: No. It is a structural beautifier that handles braces, declarations, and comments well for typical stylesheets.

faqs.question: Are comments kept?
faqs.answer: Formatting strips comments for a cleaner result. Use the original input if you need them.

faqs.question: Is my CSS uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser.
